summary: I approve with no findings. All three minors from my review of 43d90cd are fixed. (1) Batch starvation: the outer select in OutboxRelay.round() now has 'AND o.kind IN (:known)', so unknown-kind rows no longer take any of the 100 batch slots. The inner NOT EXISTS has no kind filter, so an unknown row still holds back newer rows of the same aggregate and nothing is reordered. OutboxRelayTest.unknownRowsDoNotStarveTheBatch covers this: it puts 101 BOGUS rows on separate aggregates ahead of one valid RESTORE_STOCK row and checks the valid row is delivered and DONE. The test cleans up its BOGUS rows afterwards so other test classes sharing the database are not affected. Kind.valueOf in the row mapper is now safe because the SQL only returns known kinds. (2) Logging: reportUnknown() runs once per relay() pass, not once per row per round, and logs a count plus at most 5 'id:kind' strings. It logs no payload, aggregate data or PII. It still logs once every 2 s during a rollback window, which is what was asked for. (3) The dead 'cart.fingerprint() != null' checks are gone at both places in OrderService. cartSnapshot() still refuses a cart with no fingerprint with DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE (lines 491-499), so the fingerprint can never be null on those paths. SQL injection: both IN (:known) and NOT IN (:k) use named parameters bound to a fixed list built from Kind.values(), and JdbcClient expands each into bind placeholders. LIMIT :n is bound too, and no user input reaches any of these queries. Money path: delivery only ever marks known-kind rows DONE or DEAD, and unknown rows are never changed, so no money event is skipped. That covers ORDER_EVENT/PAID, RESTORE_STOCK, RELEASE_STOCK/DEALS/EXCHANGE/COUPON/COINS, CANCEL_PAYMENT and COD_COLLECTED. Per-aggregate ordering by seq is unchanged. Wallet compensation tests match production. OrderBreakerCompensationIntegrationTest uses the real OrderRemote, WalletCreditBacks and outbox, with only the Feign clients mocked. When walletDebit is refused, production calls unwind(wallet=false), which writes the RESTORE_STOCK outbox row, and then reverseWalletDebitDurable, which writes one REVERSE_DEBIT row. When create is refused after a partial wallet debit, unwind(wallet=true) calls creditBack, which writes one row; the V9 migration defaults its kind column to 'CREDIT', and the amount is the 300.00 wallet portion. Both rows use the key 'order-wallet-back-<orderId>' with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, so the wallet is credited back at most once whichever path runs. The other changes in the delta are test-only: a Jackson encoder in the test Feign builder, AC-8 breaker tests for inventory, promotion and payment, and a looser 2 s timing assertion. No production endpoint, authz rule, /internal token check or header handling changed, no dependencies were added, and there are no secrets in the tests.
